meta.title_index: Favilla — bedtime stories in your voice
meta.desc_index: Record tonight's story in your own voice. Favilla keeps it for the nights you can't be there: no AI, no synthetic voices, and nothing that leaves your family.
meta.desc_privacy: What Favilla stores, where it lives, and what it will never do. No servers, no accounts, no tracking, no ads.

idea.title: The little light that stays on.
idea.body: In Italian, a favilla is a small spark — the ember that keeps glowing after the fire has settled. A recorded story is just that: your voice, still familiar and still yours, on a night when you can't be in the room.
idea.p1_b: Favilla has no AI and no text-to-speech. What plays in the dark is what you recorded, nothing else.
idea.p2_b: Your recordings live on your devices and in your private iCloud. Favilla has no servers, and it sees nothing.
idea.p3_b: A recording doesn't replace bedtime with you. It carries your voice on the nights you're away — and waits for the nights you're there.

how.title: From your voice to their goodnight
how.s1_b: Choose a tale from the catalog, or tell one of your own. One tap and you're reading softly while the phone listens — no setup, nothing between you and the story.
how.s2_b: The story is saved on your device, and in your private iCloud if you use it. It appears on the other family devices, and nowhere else.
how.s3_b: In the dark room, the story plays by itself. The screen stays dim and nothing asks to be touched, and a sleep timer can let it all fade away.

personas.title: For the one telling, and the one falling asleep
personas.parent_b: Tired, maybe still in the kitchen with one hand free. The app stays out of the way: choose, read, done. It never asks for more time than you have.
personas.child_b: Under the blanket, in a dark room, a voice that knows them. The screen keeps itself dim and the story needs no taps at all.

science.title: A parent's voice does a quiet thing
science.i1_b: Children recognize their parent's voice from less than a second of audio, and that voice alone can calm them — almost like being held.
science.i2_b: A steady bedtime ritual helps children fall asleep sooner and wake less often, often within the first few nights.
science.footnote: Plain-language summaries of published research on hearing a parent's voice and on bedtime rituals. The full citations live in the app, under About.

indie.title: Built by a parent, not a company
indie.body: Favilla is made by a single developer, for the same reason you would use it. No team, no funding, no committee. If it gives your child one more goodnight with your voice in it, it has done its job.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: Favilla was built to keep your family's voice where it belongs: with your family. Here is exactly what it stores, where it goes — and everything it will never do.
privacy_page.who_published: Favilla — the app — is published by
privacy_page.in_short_1: Your recordings stay yours: on your device, and in your private iCloud if you use it.
privacy_page.in_short_2: No servers, accounts, ads, analytics or third-party code. We cannot collect, see or sell your data — we never receive it.
privacy_page.in_short_3: No synthetic voices, no AI: the audio is only what you record.
privacy_page.data_t: What the app handles, and where it lives
privacy_page.data_r1c: On your device; with iCloud on, also in your private iCloud (CloudKit private database)
privacy_page.data_r2a: Story texts you write or paste
privacy_page.data_r3a: Sounds you import from your files
privacy_page.data_r3b: To play them as sleep sounds
privacy_page.data_note: Data in iCloud lives in your Apple account and is managed by Apple under its terms; the developer has no access to it. If iCloud is off or unreachable, everything stays on the device and syncs later.
privacy_page.mic_p: The microphone works only while you record. If you leave the app mid-recording, it keeps going in the background and iOS shows a small indicator with Pause and Finish. You can take the permission back in Settings. The audio is never sent to us or to anyone else.
privacy_page.dont_p: We don't track, build profiles, use advertising identifiers, share with third parties, or look at your location, photos or contacts. The clipboard is read only when you tap Paste yourself.
privacy_page.children_p: Favilla is built for a parent to record stories that a child then hears. It collects nothing from children and shows them no accounts, ads, links or purchases. The data belongs to the parent, on the parent's device.
privacy_page.retain_p: Delete a story in the app and it's gone — from the device and, through iCloud, from the other devices. Uninstalling removes local data; iCloud copies are managed in Settings › your name › iCloud › Manage Storage › Favilla. We keep no copies, because we receive no data.
privacy_page.diag_p: If you turned on Share Analytics with Apple, it may send us anonymous, aggregated crash reports. Your recordings are not in them.
privacy_page.rights_p: We neither receive nor hold your personal data, so you access, export, correct and delete it directly in the app and in iCloud settings. For anything else, write to the contact above; we answer within 30 days. Your local data protection authority is there too.
privacy_page.purch_p: Favilla is free — every story, every sound, every corner of it. Version 1.0 has no purchases at all. If that ever changes, Apple handles the payment through the App Store and we receive no payment data.
privacy_page.changes_p: If the app's handling of data ever changes, this page gets a new date and the app will tell you what matters.

support_page.title: Support
support_page.intro: Favilla is a small, honest app. Most evenings it just works — and when one doesn't, here are the answers we expect to matter.
support_page.coming_q: When can we start using Favilla?
support_page.coming_a: Favilla is on its way to the App Store. The link will appear on this page the day it arrives.
support_page.q2a: No. The app runs entirely on your device, and your recordings follow your family through your own iCloud. There is no account to create — there never will be.
support_page.q3a: On your device first, and in your private iCloud when you're signed in. They never reach a Favilla server, because there are none.
support_page.q4q: Which files can I import as sleep sounds?
support_page.q4a: m4a, mp3, wav, caf and aiff, up to 50 MB each. They sit beside the built-in sounds and travel with your library.
support_page.q5a: Delete the story or the sound in the app and it disappears everywhere — from the device and, through iCloud, from the family's other devices. Uninstalling clears the local side; iCloud lives in Settings › your name › iCloud › Manage Storage.
support_page.q6q: Can the same recordings be heard elsewhere?
support_page.q6a: Yes — that is rather the point. Everything you record is on every device signed into the same iCloud, for whoever is telling the story tonight.
support_page.contact_b: For anything else — a suggestion, a bug, a tale you'd like in the catalog — write to
support_page.contact_hint: We answer within a few days, usually after bedtime.
